subject.title: [Bug]: Docker Install + Sandbox can't workspaceAccess at all

question: Should OpenClaw add a validated host-path remapping contract for Docker Gateway/DooD sandbox managed mounts, or keep identical host/container path mapping as the supported contract?
rationale: The choice changes sandbox bind-source trust boundaries, operator setup compatibility, and whether the fix belongs in config/schema/doctor/docs or in automatic Docker mount inspection.

options.title: Define secure remapping contract
options.body: Add or sponsor validated host-path remapping for managed workspace, agent workspace, materialized skills, custom binds, and browser mounts with docs/schema/doctor coverage as needed and live DooD proof.

options.title: Keep identical-path contract
options.body: Document and enforce that Docker Gateway deployments must mount the same host path inside the Gateway container and add doctor/setup guidance for mismatches.

options.title: Land only narrow skill repair
options.body: Use the materialized-skills PR as a partial fix while keeping this canonical workspaceAccess issue open for the broader managed-mount contract.

recommendation.title: Define secure remapping contract
recommendation.body: Add or sponsor validated host-path remapping for managed workspace, agent workspace, materialized skills, custom binds, and browser mounts with docs/schema/doctor coverage as needed and live DooD proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They marked this cluster canonical and have the strongest live discussion signal plus recent Docker/sandbox history for the boundary decision.
